method.iou: art-review.py alpha_iou; alpha >127; scenery pairs at @2; ceiling anchors top-centre, floor anchors bottom-centre
method.allFrameIoU: All 52 frames including animation, HC and emissive siblings; same-ceiling pairs align top-centre, other pairs bottom-centre; no scaling or best-fit translation; every pair over 0.70 listed
method.boardIoU: manual visible counterpart polygons, unscaled drawing at 44.14 px/tile, trimmed visible bounds and anchor alignment only
method.tiers: art_tiers.visible_svg_tiers; flat pixels only; minimum 2 pixels at @2, 8 at @4, 0.5 at matched scale
method.exemptions: HC palette alternatives preserve their base silhouette; -emissive siblings hold light, not scenery; drip phases are one animation. Identity and motion pair values are reported separately.
method.context: Variant contact columns are disclosed art review composites of authored art over a committed T2 SITE-4 capture. They do not measure placement, masking, lighting or collision.
